name: tiddlywiki-kojima-media
description: Hideo Kojima Movie Recommendations, Multi-Factor Enthusiasm Ranking, and Sync Service for TiddlyWiki

scripts.serve: npm run seed-demo && TIDDLYWIKI_PLUGIN_PATH=plugins npx tiddlywiki demo --listen port=8080
scripts.build-demo: npm run seed-demo && TIDDLYWIKI_PLUGIN_PATH=plugins npx tiddlywiki demo --output build --build index
scripts.build-library: TIDDLYWIKI_PLUGIN_PATH=plugins npx tiddlywiki demo --output build/library --build library
scripts.build-all: npm run clean-runtime && npm run seed-demo && npm run build-plugin && npm run build-demo && npm run build-library && npm run clean-runtime
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:tw && npm run clean-runtime

author: Matt Blackman
